description: Read the reviews on an Angi pro's profile page: rating, body text, reported job cost, date, service categories, verification flag, and the pro's public response where one exists. Filter by rating to isolate complaints or praise.

compact.description: Return a slim summary per review instead of the full record.

limit.description: Return at most this many reviews.

maxRating.description: Keep reviews rated at most this — use maxRating: 3 to surface complaints.

minRating.description: Keep reviews rated at least this.

profileUrl.description: The pro's Angi profile URL or site-relative path, as returned in `profileUrl` by angi_search_pros (e.g. "/companylist/us/nc/charlotte/mkb-plumbing-and-septic-llc-reviews-8535260.htm").

name: angi_get_reviews
